arborec-agent.effect: Exhaust to let any player replace one non-fighter ship with a reinforcement costing up to two resources more.

arborec-commander.unlock: Have 12 ground forces on planets you control.
arborec-commander.timing: After another player activates a system containing one of your units with Production
arborec-commander.effect: You may immediately produce one unit in that system.

arborec-hero.effect: Produce any number of units across any number of systems containing your ground forces, then purge this leader.

creuss-agent.timing: After a system containing a non-delta wormhole is activated
creuss-agent.effect: Exhaust to make that system adjacent to every wormhole system for the duration of that tactical action.

creuss-commander.unlock: Have units in three systems containing alpha or beta wormholes.
creuss-commander.effect: Each capacity ship that moved through a wormhole may gain one fighter from your reinforcements if capacity is available.

creuss-hero.effect: Swap any two eligible systems containing wormholes or your units, then purge this leader. Creuss and the wormhole nexus cannot be moved.

hacan-agent.effect: Exhaust to gain two commodities or replenish another player's commodities.

hacan-commander.effect: Spend any number of trade goods to add two votes per trade good.

hacan-hero.timing: When one or more of your units use Production
hacan-hero.effect: Make every unit produced by that use cost zero resources, then purge this leader.

jolnar-agent.timing: When a player spends resources to research
jolnar-agent.effect: Exhaust to let that player remove infantry from the board, reducing the research payment by one resource per infantry.

jolnar-commander.timing: After you roll for a unit ability
jolnar-commander.effect: You may reroll any number of those dice.

jolnar-hero.effect: For each non-unit-upgrade technology you own, you may exchange it for another technology of the same color, then purge this leader.

l1z1x-agent.timing: After a player activates a system
l1z1x-agent.effect: Exhaust to let that player replace one infantry in the active system with a mech from their reinforcements.

l1z1x-commander.unlock: Have four dreadnoughts on the board.
l1z1x-commander.effect: Planetary Shield no longer prevents your units from using Bombardment.

l1z1x-hero.effect: Move your flagship and any number of dreadnoughts into one system without enemy ships, carrying units up to capacity, then purge this leader. Transported ground forces cannot land as part of this action.

letnev-agent.timing: At the start of a space-combat round
letnev-agent.effect: Exhaust to make one ship in the active system roll one additional die for that round.

letnev-commander.unlock: Have five non-fighter ships in one system.
letnev-commander.timing: After one of your units uses Sustain Damage

letnev-hero.effect: For this round, laws and fleet supply do not limit your non-fighter ships per system. Purge this leader at round end.

mentak-agent.timing: After Pillage is used against another player
mentak-agent.effect: Exhaust so both you and that player draw one action card.

mentak-commander.unlock: Have four cruisers on the board.
mentak-commander.timing: After you win a space combat
mentak-commander.effect: Force the defeated opponent to give you one promissory note from their hand.

mentak-hero.timing: At the start of a space combat you are in
mentak-hero.effect: Purge this leader; whenever another player's ship is destroyed in that combat, add your own ship of the same type to the system.

muaat-agent.effect: Exhaust and choose a player; they may produce up to two units costing four or less each in a system containing their war sun or flagship.

muaat-commander.timing: After you spend a strategy-pool token

muaat-hero.timing: After moving a war sun into an eligible non-home, non-Mecatol system
muaat-hero.effect: Destroy every other player's units there, replace the tile with the Muaat supernova, purge its planet cards, and purge this leader.

naalu-agent.effect: Exhaust and choose a player; they may perform a tactical action in a non-home system without placing a command token there, though the system still counts as activated.

naalu-commander.unlock: Have ground forces in or adjacent to the Mecatol Rex system.
naalu-commander.effect: You may view your neighbors' promissory-note hands and the top and bottom cards of the agenda deck.

naalu-hero.timing: At the end of the status phase
naalu-hero.effect: Force every other player to give you one promissory note from hand, then purge this leader.

nekro-agent.effect: Exhaust and choose a player; they may discard an action card or spend a command token to gain two trade goods.

nekro-commander.unlock: Own three technologies; a Valefar Assimilator counts only while its token is assigned.

nekro-hero.effect: Choose a technology-specialty planet in a system containing your units. Destroy enemy units on it, gain trade goods equal to its resource-plus-influence value, copy a technology matching its specialty, then purge this leader.

norr-agent.timing: At the end of a player's tactical action
norr-agent.effect: Exhaust to let that player place two infantry on a controlled planet in the active system.

norr-commander.unlock: Control five planets in non-home systems.
norr-commander.effect: Commit up to one ground force from each planet in the active or adjacent systems, provided those systems do not contain your command tokens.

norr-hero.timing: After you move ships into the active system
norr-hero.effect: Skip directly to committing ground forces. After committing, return all your ships in the active system to reinforcements and purge this leader.

saar-agent.timing: When a player activates a system
saar-agent.effect: Exhaust to raise one of that player's ships to the highest move value currently printed on any ship on the board.

saar-commander.unlock: Have three space docks on the board.
saar-commander.timing: When you produce fighters or infantry
saar-commander.effect: Place each produced fighter or infantry at any of your un-blockaded space docks instead of only at the producing dock.

saar-hero.effect: Choose a system adjacent to one of your space docks, destroy all other players' infantry and fighters there, then purge this leader.

sol-agent.timing: At the start of a ground-combat round
sol-agent.effect: Exhaust to make one ground force in the active system roll one additional die for that round.

sol-commander.unlock: Control planets worth at least 12 total resources.
sol-commander.timing: At the start of ground combat on a planet you control
sol-commander.effect: Place one infantry from your reinforcements on that planet.

sol-hero.effect: Remove all of your command tokens from the board and return them to your reinforcements, then purge this leader.

winnu-agent.timing: When a player's units use Production
winnu-agent.effect: Exhaust to reduce that use's combined resource cost by two.

winnu-commander.unlock: Control Mecatol Rex or enter combat in its system.
winnu-commander.effect: Add two to your combat rolls in Mecatol Rex, your home system, and systems containing legendary planets.

winnu-hero.effect: Resolve the primary of any strategy card, then let any chosen players resolve its secondary; purge this leader afterward.

xxcha-agent.effect: Exhaust to ready any planet. If it is adjacent to a planet you control, you may also remove one infantry from it.

xxcha-commander.unlock: Control planets worth at least 12 total influence.
xxcha-commander.effect: Each planet exhausted for votes supplies one extra vote, and effects cannot stop you from voting.

xxcha-hero.effect: Add each planet's resource and influence values together and treat the total as both values. This is a persistent effect once the hero is unlocked.

yin-agent.timing: After any player's unit is destroyed
yin-agent.effect: Exhaust to let that player place two fighters in the system if a ship was destroyed, or two infantry on the planet if a ground force was destroyed.

yin-commander.unlock: Use one of your faction abilities.
yin-commander.effect: This leader supplies one green prerequisite. When researching another player's technology, you may also return one infantry to ignore every prerequisite.

yin-hero.effect: Commit up to three infantry from reinforcements to non-home planets and resolve ground combats there without Space Cannon fire, then purge this leader.

yssaril-agent.timing: Passive; use at the copied agent's timing
yssaril-agent.effect: This leader has the text ability of every other player's agent, even while that other agent is exhausted.

yssaril-commander.timing: After another player activates a system containing your units
yssaril-commander.effect: Inspect that player's action cards, promissory notes, or secret objectives.

yssaril-hero.effect: Each opponent reveals an action card. For each player, either take the revealed card or make that player discard three random action cards, then purge this leader.

argent-agent.timing: When a player produces ground forces in a system
argent-agent.effect: Exhaust to let them distribute those new units among controlled planets in that system and adjacent systems.

argent-commander.unlock: Have six units with Anti-Fighter Barrage, Space Cannon, or Bombardment.
argent-commander.timing: When your units roll for a unit ability
argent-commander.effect: Choose one participating unit to roll one additional die.

argent-hero.effect: Move any number of your ships into systems containing your command tokens and no enemy ships, carrying units up to capacity, then purge this leader. Transported ground forces cannot land during this action.

cabal-agent.effect: Exhaust to convert those commodities to trade goods and capture one unit from that player's reinforcements costing no more than their commodity value.

cabal-commander.unlock: Have units in three gravity rifts.
cabal-commander.timing: When you produce fighters or infantry
cabal-commander.effect: Up to two of those units do not count against the Production limit.

cabal-hero.effect: Every opponent rolls for each non-fighter ship in or next to a dimensional tear; results of 1–3 are captured, along with unsupported fighters or ground forces. Then purge this leader.

empyrean-agent.timing: After a player moves ships into a system with no planets
empyrean-agent.effect: Exhaust to give that player one command token.

empyrean-commander.unlock: Be neighbors with every other player.
empyrean-commander.timing: After another player moves into a system containing one of your command tokens
empyrean-commander.effect: Return that token to your reinforcements.

empyrean-hero.effect: Seed every eligible empty-space system with a frontier token, then explore each frontier token in systems containing your ships. Purge this leader afterward.

mahact-agent.timing: When you would spend a command token on a strategy card's secondary
mahact-agent.effect: Exhaust to remove one of the active player's board tokens and spend that token instead.

mahact-commander.unlock: Have two other factions' command tokens in your fleet pool.
mahact-commander.timing: During one of your tactical actions
mahact-commander.effect: You may activate a system already containing your command token; return both tokens involved to reinforcements and end your turn.

mahact-hero.effect: Move every unit in one system's space area into an adjacent system containing a different player's ships. Those players fight and cannot retreat or move ships away; then purge this leader.

naaz-agent.timing: At the end of a player's turn
naaz-agent.effect: Exhaust to let that player explore one of their planets.

naaz-commander.timing: After taking a planet from another player

naaz-hero.effect: Gain one relic and resolve the secondary of up to two readied or unchosen strategy cards, spending command tokens from reinforcements. Then purge this leader.

nomad-agent-artuno.timing: When you gain trade goods from the supply
nomad-agent-artuno.effect: Exhaust to bank the same number on this leader; collect those banked trade goods when the leader readies.

nomad-agent-mercer.timing: At the end of a player's turn
nomad-agent-mercer.effect: Exhaust to let that player relocate up to two ground forces from anywhere on the board to controlled planets in the active system.

nomad-agent-thundarian.effect: Exhaust to cancel hit assignment for both sides and repeat that combat round from the roll-dice step.

nomad-commander.effect: You may produce your flagship without paying resources.

nomad-hero.effect: For the rest of the round, your flagship and the units it carries may move out of systems containing your command tokens. Purge this leader at round end.

titans-agent.timing: Immediately before a hit is assigned

titans-commander.unlock: Have five structures on the board.
titans-commander.timing: When one or more of your units use Production

titans-hero.effect: Ready Elysium and permanently attach this leader to it. Elysium gains three resources, three influence, and Space Cannon 5 with three dice.

keleres-agent.effect: Exhaust to let any player spend commodities as though they were trade goods.

keleres-commander.unlock: After playing an action card with a component action, spend one trade good.
keleres-commander.timing: After you perform a component action

keleres-hero-argent.timing: At the start of a space-combat round in a system containing your planet
keleres-hero-argent.effect: Place your flagship plus up to two cruisers or destroyers from reinforcements into the active system, then purge this leader.

keleres-hero-mentak.effect: Reveal the action deck until three component-action cards appear, draw those three, reshuffle the rest, then purge this leader.

keleres-hero-xxcha.effect: Add up to six votes and predict the result. For each player voting for a different result, gain one trade good and one command token; then purge this leader.

redcreuss-agent.unlock: Always unlocked in the Liberation of Ordinian scenario.
redcreuss-agent.effect: Exhaust and choose a player; that player may swap two of their ships anywhere on the board and transport units with them.

redcreuss-commander.unlock: Resolve a combat with another player.
redcreuss-commander.timing: At the end of a combat between any players
redcreuss-commander.effect: Gain one commodity or convert one commodity into a trade good.

redcreuss-hero.timing: When you produce ships; later, at the start of space combat
redcreuss-hero.effect: Store any ships you produce on this leader. At the start of a later space combat, purge it to deploy every stored ship into the active system.

salientsun-hero.unlock: The Nekro Virus has five victory points in Liberation of Ordinian.
salientsun-hero.timing: When one of your units in the Ordinian system is destroyed
salientsun-hero.effect: Purge this leader and use that unit as the catalyst. Roll once for every other player's unit there; destroy each unit whose roll meets the catalyst's combat value.
